why: machines-home: the Machines page needs a top-page home again. Its host glue registers MachineSectionHostView (an App type that reads AppServices' machine registry, hub client and registry menus) as an InternalPageID page with a machines.show effect, beside the Automations page in TopPages; the route case and page id live on App-owned TopPageRoute and InternalPageID. The host now reads the joined list when the page enters a window. No logic moves into the App: the page is the existing React MachineSectionPageProvider.
